guidance: Prepare a UTF-8 JSON input file inside this session workspace with prompt and either schema for structured generation, or output_format: markdown without schema for plain Markdown. Optional images are objects with path. Pass input_path, a new output_path in an existing workspace directory, and a unique request_id. The output file contains output_text and usage. Model, provider and credentials are bound by the host; input metadata cannot override them. No tools or parent conversation history are available to the isolated generator. Failure does not authorize automatic retry.

request_schema.description: Run one isolated generation with the active conversation's resolved model.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum execution time before cancellation and confirmed cleanup; no automatic retry.
timeout_seconds.title: Timeout Seconds
